description: Search United Real Estate homes for sale by city and state, ZIP code, keyword or map radius, look up listings by URL or MLS number, and optionally add full property details such as photos, description, year built, lot size, coordinates and listing-agent contact.

city.description: City to search, e.g. `Austin`. For mode=search; combine with `state`.
city.title: City

includeDetails.description: Open each listing page and add photos, description, year built, lot size, MLS number, county, coordinates, tax amount, amenities, feature lists and listing-agent contact. Slower because it makes one extra request per listing. In search/nearby mode it also post-filters by the requested property type when the detail type is recognized. For mode=search and mode=nearby.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Optional enrichment from each listing's detail page.
includeDetails.title: Include full property details

keyword.description: Free-text search across listing addresses, descriptions and MLS numbers, e.g. `waterfront`, `pool` or `1191266`. For mode=search.
keyword.title: Keyword

latitude.sectionDescription: Coordinate-radius search. Used only by mode=nearby.
latitude.title: Latitude

listingStatuses.description: Restrict to one or more listing statuses. Empty = the site default (active listings). For mode=search.
listingStatuses.title: Listing status

listingUrls.description: United Real Estate listing page URLs or paths, e.g. `https://www.unitedrealestate.com/home/for-sale/austin-tx/3808-balcones-dr/60134949`. For mode=byUrls.

url.description: A full United Real Estate listing URL or listing path.
url.title: Listing URL

listingUrls.sectionDescription: Use these instead of a location search to fetch specific listings.
listingUrls.title: Listing URLs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted listings. Search results are fetched 250 at a time.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Controls how many records are saved and how the dataset is displayed.
maxItems.title: Max items

mlsNumbers.description: MLS listing numbers to look up, e.g. `1191266`. Each is searched nationwide and a record is emitted only when the listing detail page shows the exact MLS number. For mode=byMlsNumbers.
mlsNumbers.title: MLS numbers

mode.description: What to fetch. `search` finds listings by location, ZIP, keyword or map radius. `byUrls` scrapes specific listing pages. `byMlsNumbers` looks listings up by MLS number. `nearby` searches around a latitude/longitude point.
mode.title: Mode

propertyTypes.description: Restrict to one or more property types. Empty = all types. With includeDetails, results are post-filtered by the detail property type when the source label is recognized. For mode=search.
propertyTypes.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied to search results. They are ignored by the URL and MLS modes.
propertyTypes.title: Property types

radiusMiles.description: Approximate search radius around the coordinate point. The source uses a map bounding box, so corner results can be farther than this value. For mode=nearby.
radiusMiles.title: Radius (miles)

state.description: US state for the city search. For mode=search.
state.title: State

zipCode.description: Search a US ZIP code instead of city/state. Five digits, e.g. `78701`. For mode=search.
zipCode.title: ZIP code

title: United Real Estate Scraper Input
